scope: General validation/training-derived label shapes and independently authored adversarial statements. No heldout response is a test fixture. Existing value.acc/gates/profiles remain unchanged.
contract: Extract the requested refdes from a small explicit set of supported user-question forms, using only the aligned user text. For native-evidence first turns, parse the terminal question paragraph and never select a refdes from the JSON evidence blob.

Accept one affirmative, unambiguous marked/recorded-value claim (or one bare value) for the requested component. Allow a bounded set of wrappers such as R7 is marked VALUE, R7 has value VALUE in the source schematic, or The value shown next to R7 is VALUE. The entire answer must match; correct substrings are insufficient.

Any negation, alternatives, ranges, multiple component/value claims, contradictory tails, or unsupported wrappers require manual review and do not automatically pass. Do not infer the final correct claim from not A but B.

First support simple single-quantity capacitance/inductance/resistance labels with SI normalization using exact decimal arithmetic. Require dimension equality; distinguish milli from mega. Treat u/µ/μ as micro. Infer omitted resistance units only when the gold quantity is a supported resistor shorthand and the question targets a resistor reference.

Opaque part numbers, connector names, and qualified labels use a strict whole-value literal branch. Do not drop Pack, tolerance, wattage, voltage ratings, or part suffixes. Unsupported compound quantity labels remain literal/manual rather than guessing a semantic parse.

Return accepted/status/reason/version details. Unknown question forms or semantically plausible paraphrases are manual_review, not proof of model hallucination. Provide separate version metadata and opt-in CLI/API; never silently replace v1 or rescore a published release.

implementation_boundary.arithmetic: decimal.Decimal with fixed SI scale exponents; no 2% numeric tolerance for printed part labels
implementation_boundary.opaque_labels: exact normalized whitespace and presentation markup only; do not reinterpret digit-bearing part numbers as quantities
implementation_boundary.equivalent_quantity_explanations: Even correct two-value explanations fail the initial closed grammar and are marked manual_review. A future supported equation grammar requires separate adversarial tests.

limitations: This defines a stricter answer-format contract with electrical unit equivalence, not a general natural-language semantic judge.
Literal marking and nominal electrical value are distinct tasks for qualified labels. The proposal preserves qualifiers rather than using the nominal value to excuse an incomplete transcription.
Bespoke component prefixes and ambiguous unitless labels cannot safely imply a dimension; require explicit context or leave manual.
No model prompt, answer, gold label, dataset, metric gate, or benchmark score was changed for this proposal.
